activity_summary: At supper you said you had left the Keys at eleven and were not in The Shrew. Mistress Ansell would not rule that play off one sentence, and she did not reopen her January verdict on the comedy. The latch stuck and sprang, and she left it on the door. The letter still waits for the carrier of the 27th. Your board was threepence.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the afternoon was the company's, kept Thursday's verdict as she had given it, and named no new errand.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Carried the pot, withheld a ruling on The Shrew, and left the latch where it was.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked about dinner and the ladies, and did not take a house candle.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Said he had seen the afternoon bill and had not stayed.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The Shrew was their bill at two. I was not in it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I will not rule it off a single sentence.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It waits for the carrier on the twenty-seventh.
